caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing figure with dark brown skin and long black hair, dressed in clothing and accessories with various bright colors. The figure wears a tall and elaborate feathered headdress with feathers in red, white, yellow, and green, fastened by a yellow band. The figure has a red garment draped over one shoulder and is adorned with striped sashes and borders in red, yellow, white, green, and blue. The figure holds a bundle labeled "INDUSTRY" in its left hand and has its right hand raised to its forehead as if shielding its eyes to look into the distance. A green necklace and yellow armbands are visible. The figure stands on a faux rock above a platform that resembles stacked boxes or books, mounted on four wheels. The boxes are labeled in blue capital letters with the words “CIGARS,” “TOBACCO,” "C.H. MANLEY & CO.," and "INDUSTRY CIGARS." The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Cigar Store Indian
